architecture.positioning: Independent visual atlas and evidence-linked deep wiki for underwater hockey; transparent about regional gaps and unverified club activity.

marker_rules: Never place a federation office as a playing venue
Use distinct city/region circles and exact-venue pins
Null coordinates stay in searchable list until geocoded
A precise numeric coordinate from a crowd map does not imply a verified pool
Cluster without counting duplicates as separate clubs
Historical and stopped clubs off by default

wiki_article_template: At a glance: audience, geography and edition
What varies by jurisdiction, event or coaching school
club_page_template: Beginner access and loan equipment if source-supported
Schedule as a dated source quote or outbound link, not guaranteed current
Reported status vs independently verified status
science_topics: No unsupervised apnea prescription or medical clearance claims

repository_data_design.sources: One canonical bibliographic resource record; original summaries only
repository_data_design.organizations: Stable IDs; umbrella, sport body, region, club and event organizer separated
repository_data_design.locations: Venue, geocode precision, active-status evidence and contact source separate
repository_data_design.claims: Claim-level source IDs and confidence; conflicts retained
repository_data_design.assets: Original or explicitly licensed assets with licence and attribution manifest
repository_data_design.schema_validation: Validate IDs, URLs, dates, ISO codes, coordinate ranges, orphan references and source completeness

proposed_article_backlog: How to find a club responsibly
How to read the UWH research literature
Watching a match: annotated viewing guide
content_boundary: Underwater hockey/octopush only; distinguish underwater rugby and underwater ice hockey
No personal player directory or junior rosters
Do not republish third-party photos, logo collections or full PDFs without rights
Do not translate rules as if translations were authoritative
Keep current rules separate from local variations and historical editions

data_quality_flags.finding: The UWH Map all-clubs headline is a crowdsourced snapshot, not a census of operating clubs.
data_quality_flags.action: Label directory coverage; never state all clubs globally or infer player populations.

data_quality_flags.finding: Widely linked French directory is 2022–2023 despite a recent crawl.
data_quality_flags.action: Mark historical; do not publish training times as current.

data_quality_flags.finding: CMAS currently lists CBES for UWH; CBPDS is suspended. CBPDS hockey copy also contains obvious generic chatbot-like phrasing.
data_quality_flags.action: Use CMAS affiliation evidence and do not promote CBPDS as current international authority or rely on its uncorroborated city claims.

data_quality_flags.finding: NOVA crowd record’s text says UBC pool while map field points at Vancouver Aquatic Centre. CUGA agrees with UBC.
data_quality_flags.action: Incorrect crowd pin rejected; replaced with UBC OSM-derived facility point corroborated against club-owned venue and official facility address. Contact for exact practice times.

data_quality_flags.finding: CUGA repeats Gatineau-Ottawa and lists Guelph Instagram text matching Waterloo.
data_quality_flags.action: Deduplicate organization and do not copy potentially mismatched social handles.

data_quality_flags.finding: National affiliation, event participation and local practice availability are different facts.
data_quality_flags.action: Do not infer local hockey from generic diving federation presence; absence of a CMAS hockey label also does not prove no grassroots club exists.

data_quality_flags.finding: Publicly viewable does not mean freely redistributable. BOA graphics permission is member-limited; CMAS reserves rights.
data_quality_flags.action: Use original graphics, outbound links and verified embeddings; maintain licence manifest.

data_quality_flags.finding: Small observational/laboratory studies and case reports answer different questions.
data_quality_flags.action: Label evidence type and limits; do not turn average submersion times into safety guarantees or prescribe apnea training.

data_quality_flags.finding: Some official sources and crowd-map details failed text fetch; JavaScript maps expose incomplete records.
data_quality_flags.action: Treat unread content as unverified, not absent. Use permitted browser/manual review in later implementation.

coverage_gaps: Many countries have discovery-only records rather than independently verified live clubs
Latin America outside Argentina and Colombia needs deeper local verification; Brazil evidence distinguishes historical programs from current activity
Africa sample is South Africa only; national and grassroots coverage elsewhere requires follow-up

Twelve sourced coordinates now available: nine UWH Map-derived, two OSM-derived venue points and one suburb-level point. All explicitly identify precision and evidence limitations; remaining official venues are not yet geocoded.
Source licences, video playback/embedding and individual document versions need item-level checks before redistribution
No exhaustive club scraping, personal roster collection, photo identification, GitHub publishing or app build performed
research_followups: Geocode official pool addresses with documented provider/licence and verify facilities
Check current club-owned session pages and date each assertion
Reconcile duplicates and historical clubs before total counts
Acquire open-licensed original illustrations and request any third-party media permissions
Expand country pages from official sources in local languages
Add item-level match archive links and timestamps without downloading copyrighted footage
